note: Accounts that Zoho keeps as ONE ledger account but the signed workbook (BS Grouping) lists line by line. The ledger of each account (General Ledger Details, 01-Mar-2025 to the balance sheet date) is split row by row into the lines of the sheet by WORDS: in the row's own text, or - for a split with legs=true - in the journal behind the row (its notes and the names of its other accounts, for example 'IOB FD no. 015804000012280'). A row that names no part goes to the part marked rest (if there is one), otherwise it stays unassigned and the block compares it in total. A part that gets no row is not used (its line is then compared in total as before). All of this is checked against the Trial Balance: if the ledger of the account does not add up to the Trial Balance's closing balance, the split is not used. The same file also holds party_splits: a CONTACT that the sheet lists twice (an insurer as advance in one note and as payable in another, RPE Energy Reserve as loan and as advance) is split by the Zoho ledger account its entries sit in - the accounts a part names, and the part marked rest takes every other account of the contact. Nothing more is read from Zoho for this - except that a part may carry bill_state (HDFC ERGO's payable: Rajasthan / Delhi): it then takes the BILLS of its accounts whose billing-address state is one of those states, read from the bill itself (one small read per bill, kept 12 hours); a bill that cannot be read stays out of the split and is compared in total. If a part is on the other side of the ledger than the sheet shows it, or the contact has no balance, the split is not used and the sheet compares the contact's one balance.
